## `neuro.object.entries`

Static method on `Object`.

> Returns an array of key/values of the enumerable own properties of an object

## Signatures

```ts
entries(input: { o: { [s: string]: T; } | ArrayLike<T>; prompt?: string }): Promise<[string, T][]>
entries(input: { o: {}; prompt?: string }): Promise<[string, any][]>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Object.entries` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
